body:
## Lane A: Jev-gate dispatch skip (JS port + WGSL integration)
- **js/jev_gate.js**: ternary per-cell dispatch (Value/Formula/Abstain), neighborhood coherence via von Neumann radius, one-way upgrade per frame, zero-alloc typed arrays
- **shaders/glyph_election.wgsl**: `cell_dirty` binding(5) — Abstain cells skip election entirely, prior token stays resident
- **webgpu.html**: JevGate wired into render loop, dirty buffer GPU upload, perf EMA meter

## Lane B: Sobel descriptor (code ready, receipt pending)
- **js/sobel_shape.js**: bivariate (L,θ,g) descriptor per 4x6 cell, orientation-gated election
- **tools/sobel_agree.py**: 30-frame offline agreement test with pre-registered verdict rule (<0.95 = integrate). NOT YET RUN — needs ~30s CPU or GPU.

## Lane C: Edge NL eval (50-prompt, pre-registered)
- **edge/eval_prompts.json**: 50 prompts across 5 style classes (R2 pre-registration)
- **edge/score_eval.py**: mirror of worker.ts STYLE_RULES, deterministic scorer
- **Result**: top-1 = 0.560. Soft class weakest (0.29). 22 failures = synonym/paraphrase probes (documented per-failure). Round 3 should replace keyword table with bounded model.

## Lane D: JEPA token quantization
- **tools/token_stream.py**: K=32 codebook, k-means on SVD k=3 projections, numpy only, all seeds pinned
- **Result**: train MSE=0.001007, holdout MSE=0.001024 (overfit gap 0.98), null-lift 6.08x, 1280x theoretical compression

4 lanes, 11 files, +820 lines. Main untouched.
title: Round 5: Jev-gate dispatch skip + edge NL eval + JEPA token quantization + Sobel descriptor (4 lanes)
